items.question: What specific ritual repetition is enjoined upon the practitioner worshipped by the gods?
premises: The practice involves a hundred thousand repetitions.
These repetitions are situated in the mass of syllables on the forehead.
The instruction is addressed to one who is worshipped by the gods.
items.inference: The god-worshipped practitioner is enjoined to perform a hundred thousand repetitions focused on the syllables located on the forehead.
uncertainties: The exact nature of the repetition (mantra, breath, or visualization) is not specified in this verse alone.
The continuation of the instruction depends on the following context beyond this verse.
items.plain_english: O one worshipped by the gods, having performed a hundred thousand repetitions situated in the mass of syllables on the forehead...
